ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. Credit is not given for both PS 100 and this particular section of PS 199. Clarification of the assessment notations listed above: graduate students will be assessed $309 per credit hour; undergrad students will be assessed $277 per credit hour. All students will be assessed a $45 per credit hour administration fee. These assessments are in addition to the campus range assessments if students also take an on-campus class. Foundations of Political Science is designed for students planning on majoring in Political Science. The course provides an introduction to the discipline of political science and the ways in which social scientists ask and answer questions about politics.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $309.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $277.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $45.00 per Bill Hour.
